item.title: Enzo Temmerman breaks femur
item.description: Young Kawasaki rider, Enzo Temmerman, was only back on the bike after surgery on his leg but is now back on the injured list immediately after this horrific crash (via Temmerman’s IG) that left the 2025 Loretta Lynn’s winner with a broken femur. A gutted Temmerman said on social media: “Very frustrated with what happened...

item.title: Video: TLD Ducati – the making of the team
item.description: Get a behind the scenes look at the formation of the Troy Lee Designs Ducati team that will debut the prestigious brand in Supercross this weekend with Dylan Ferrandis and Justin Barcia.

item.title: Gallery: Anaheim pits – Friday
item.description: The bikes and teams are on show as round one of the highly anticipated 2026 AMA Supercross season gets underway with press day – the high winds mean it’s a bit of a mission for the teams to put the awnings up!

item.title: First look: Tim Gajser on the Factory Yamaha
item.description: Tim Gajser has travelled to Sardinia as he starts to get to work on his new Yamaha machine. It’s a good place to put in the work as the track gets rough and there’s a GP there later in the year. See his early laps on the Yamaha below – courtesy of Yamaha Racing.

item.title: Interview: Haiden Deegan on going 450, mind games, Herlings and de Wolf!
item.description: We caught up with Haiden Deegan to discuss staying 250 in Supercross, going 450 outdoors, continuing the mind games plus his thoughts on de Wolf and Herlings.

item.title: Interview: Eli Tomac on ditching the scoop tyre
item.description: Eli Tomac revealed he won’t be using the scoop tyre at every race this year after having issues in the whoops in Australia during WSX, and that he still gets butterflies at A1! Eli told us: “We’ve made improvements. Biggest thing was actually that tyre, especially the whoops, I mean, look, I was getting killed...

item.title: Interview: Jorge Prado – happy and confident
item.description: Jorge Prado has his smile back again and the friendly Spaniard is positive about his progress in Supercross after finally getting a full off-season prep and being back on KTM.

item.title: Interview: Hunter Lawrence talks Supercross 2026 and Jett Lawrence crash
item.description: We caught up with Hunter Lawrence to discuss his brilliant 2025 season, hopes for 2026 and not having Jett with him on the track. item.title: Results: 2026 Dortmund Supercross (Friday)
item.description: In the SX1 main event it was the French evasion as they went 1-2-3. It was Maxime Desprey who took the win over Greg Aranda with Jordi Tixier rounding out the podium. item.description: We got to catch up briefly with Haiden Deegan’s dad, Brian, to get his perspective on why Haiden stayed on a 250 for one more Supercross season before moving to the 450 outdoors.
